name: Friuli Annia

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.
Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.
Indicazione Geografica Tipica, Italy's broad regional tier.
An aged Italian wine. Chianti Riserva needs at least 6 months in barrel and 3 more in bottle before release.

notes: Friuli's whites stress pure fruit and acidity, usually without the mask of oak.
Friulano makes crisp, floral wines that develop notes of nuts and fennel with age.
Friuli Pinot Grigio is fuller bodied than most in northeast Italy, with delicate peach, almond and green apple.
Refosco dal Peduncolo Rosso, the best known local red, is herbal, full bodied and ages well.

blurb.text: A Friuli-Venezia Giulia DOC, set up in 1995, covering eight communes including Marano Lagunare. Its rules allow still and sparkling wine.
